about.f4: I am a Computer Science graduate and Junior PHP Developer based in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. I support PHP/MySQL web applications and have practical knowledge of Laravel, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery and AJAX. My work includes CRUD operations, SQL queries, RESTful API integration, JSON responses and backend/frontend debugging. I am keen to learn from experienced developers and contribute to reliable, maintainable web applications.
